rulings.Case Title: FREDRIC VINNA VS. YAN HONG-HEIM ET AL
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 10, 2026. Line 2. DEFENDANT MODERN ART CONSTRUCTION DEMURRER to COMPLAINT is OVERRULED, 10 days to answer. The first cause of action against the moving defendant is sufficiently stated and is not barred by the statute of limitations or repose. Assuming, and without so holding, that the "completed and accepted" doctrine is applicable, the moving party improperly raised factual disputes re: patent vs. latent defect and reasonableness of inspection. Factual disputes are not appropriate on a demurrer and to be decided by a trier of fact, not a judge on a motion. =(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849).
